explication: Windows Forms is a .NET framework for building Windows desktop applications. The principal workflow is: a developer starts from an application template, designs controls in Visual Studio, and produces an app that receives Windows messages, dispatches them to controls, lays them out, and renders UI through GDI+. Design-time services add drag/drop alignment and undo. The runtime also supports OLE component/message management, accessibility events, printing, and print preview. Some subsystems are represented by directory paths because their detailed sources were not sampled.
